changelog:
- Initial release of Web Search Bing CN Skill.
- Supports Chinese search via Bing China, returning clean results.
- Opens the host browser for login only when required by the accessed site.
- Detects login needs in real-time based on page status, not pre-judgment.
- Allows users to fetch and parse the search result page content.
- No extra dependencies required—uses OpenClaw’s built-in browser tool.
summary: 通过无头浏览器在必应中国版进行中文搜索，实时检测登录需求并在必要时启动浏览器供用户登录。
